flow: Start with buyer, seller, or purchase intent; inspect actual search results and exact-query targeting rather than trusting difficulty scores alone.
Group related queries into page opportunities, compare ranking coverage with published coverage, and prioritize contested topical gaps.
Organize market pages, categories, and contextual content networks; plan publication order and connect detailed pages through relevant internal links.
Develop local lead-generation assets and programmatic or AI content workflows, alongside the corpus's backlink, digital PR, parasite SEO, and expired-domain strategies.
Evaluate CTR and user-signal claims alongside local and AI search visibility; account for reporting conditions, ongoing costs, and reversals rather than equating appearances with clicks.
Investigate indexing, crawl behavior, and traffic drops; assess rental, commission, advertising, affiliate, agency, SaaS, directory, and website-investment models against business results.
